description: This file defines constants, enums, data structures, and function prototypes for LAN management API, including host information, network management, and socket communication functions.

methods.name: lm_get_all_hosts
methods.description: Retrieves all host entries into provided structure.

methods.name: lm_get_host_by_mac
methods.description: Fetches host information based on MAC address.

methods.name: lm_set_host_comments
methods.description: Sets comments for a specific host identified by MAC.

methods.name: lm_add_network
methods.description: Adds a new network with specified name.

methods.name: lm_delete_network
methods.description: Deletes a network with specified name.

methods.name: lm_get_network
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specified network.

methods.name: lm_get_online_device
methods.description: Gets the number of online devices.

methods.name: init_client_socket
methods.description: Initializes a client socket for communication.

methods.name: lm_send_rev
methods.description: Sends a command and receives a response over socket.
